games.name: Totally Accurate Tops (Open Alpha)

A Beyblade physics simulator with custom content. EVERYTHING IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE. The game is in Alpha.

Build a spinning top, bond with spirits to develop signature moves, & battle your friends with (sometimes goofy) physics inspired by the Beyblade metal series!

- Click/tap to throw your top
- Battle players and enter tournaments to earn money
- Buy parts and collect spirits from meteors
- Master spirits to unlock Signature Moves

📄 Stamina counters defense
